epics.title: HI-3593 SPI command and control register surface

requirements.text: The SPI interface shall discard incomplete command bytes when CS deasserts.
The command decoder shall support the complete datasheet-defined digital opcode table.

All defined opcodes 00, 04, 08, 0C, 10, 14, 18, 24, 28, 2C, 34, 38, 40, 44, 48, 4C, 80, 84, 90, 94, 98, 9C, A0, A4, A8, AC, B0, B4, B8, BC, C0, C4, C8, CC, D0, D4, and FF shall be decoded with documented side effects.
TX/RX status read opcodes shall report FIFO and mailbox status observable through SPI.
The ACLK division register shall be readable and writeable through opcodes 38h and D4h.
External MR and opcode 04h shall restore the master reset state.
Opcode 44h shall clear FIFO and priority mailbox state without clearing ordinary control registers or label memories.
TX FIFO full writes shall be ignored, and RX FIFO shall retain the most recent 32 received words.

epics.title: Receiver label recognition and priority mailbox behavior

requirements.text: Each receiver shall implement a 256-bit label recognition memory with write, read, and set-all opcodes.
Each receiver shall implement three priority-label match registers with write/read and opcode 44h clear behavior.
PLON-enabled received words matching a priority label shall update a double-buffered priority mailbox and support mailbox read opcodes.
R1FLAG, R2FLAG, R1INT, and R2INT shall follow the flag/interrupt assignment register source selections.
The digital boundary shall expose MB1_1, MB1_2, MB1_3, MB2_1, MB2_2, and MB2_3 mailbox-valid outputs.
The RTL shall model digital ARINC TX/RX pins while excluding analog bus voltage and slew claims.
The RX path shall assemble accepted words into receiver FIFOs.
The TX path shall pop TX FIFO data and drive TX1IN/TX0IN/SLP digital controls.
The TX engine shall implement TFLIP, HIZ, TMODE, TPARITY, ODDEVEN, RATE, SELFTEST, parity insertion, and transmit start behavior.
The RX engine shall implement RFLIP, SDI, parity, label recognition, PLON priority filtering, and rate-class checks.
The Loop3 PS/PL prototype shall expose the observable digital register, SPI, status, mailbox, and TX/RX pin surface without claiming analog signoff.
